text: Jennifer Niece, Manager, Strategic Policy and Innovation, Transportation Services, will provide a presentation of the findings from a needs assessment conducted by Transportation Services in late 2022/early 2023 regarding accessibility on the City's sidewalks and streets. The assessment included interviews with key stakeholder organizations, an organizational survey and a randomized, representative public survey of Torontonians with disabilities.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee requested that: 1. The General Manager, Transportation Services consider re-evaluating the definition of disability to be more in alignment with the social model of disability by including such words as "the experience of those interacting with " and include an update of any revised definition in the presentation expected for the September 5, 2023 Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee.
